connector.name: MCP Victoriatraces
connector.registryDescription: MCP Server for VictoriaTraces. Provides integration with VictoriaTraces API and documentation
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-victoriatraces:1.5.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the victoriametrics-community account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VT_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT
env.description: URL to VictoriaTraces instance (it should be root URL of vtlingle or vtselect), for example http://localhost:10428

env.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable
